title: Matrix LR down-sweep (MATRIX_LR 0.04 -> 0.03)
description: Lowered MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.03 (25% decrease), all else unchanged from DEPTH=10 baseline.
reflection: val_bpb 1.005875, worse than baseline 1.002279 and essentially the mirror image of the round-2 increase to 0.05 (which gave ~1.0058-1.006). This confirms MATRIX_LR=0.04 sits at a local optimum in both directions -- no further MATRIX_LR scalar sweeps are worth running. Combined with rounds 1-3, four different single-axis perturbations (depth up, matrix_lr up, matrix_lr down, warmdown longer) have now all failed to beat the DEPTH=10 baseline, suggesting future rounds should try a genuinely different axis (e.g. window pattern, head_dim, total batch size, or embedding/weight-decay tuning) rather than more scalar nudges near the current baseline.
